title: Ning Li and Podkletnov rotating superconductors

tellings.quote: But then you got Ming Le's work with the rotating superconductor of IBCO. Also, Eugene Pleutnov used rotating superconductors

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about two scientists, Ning Li and Eugene Podkletnov, who he says each worked with spinning superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance when very cold. He mentions Ning Li's work with a spinning disc made of a superconducting material called YBCO. He raises it among claims that such devices might produce unusual effects on gravity, which would matter greatly for flight if true.
